label: Lung cancer (NSCLC)
site_note: V2 item 5.3 (two primaries): only on a Case File linked to the same patient's other Case File, and only for histopathology, cytology, IHC and molecular records: among several candidates for one record, or several documents carrying a required value, one that names another protocol's site and not this one steps aside and is named on the row for review; a document naming no site never does, and when every candidate names another site every candidate stays. Organ words only. A preference, never a filter; a patient with one cancer is checked as before.
note: Configurable by the clinical team. The required records are rebuilt from the NCG Essential / Optimal / Optional tiers per setting (NCG thoracic cancer guidelines 2019, quoted with page on every record), then informed by ICMR, ESMO and CAP as before; to be confirmed by the hospital Tumour Board (clinical review before real use).
settings_note: NCG setting of the Case File, chosen by the clinician from what the signed reports record (the system never computes stage). Item 4.1 derives the required records per setting from the NCG tiers.

records.label: Clinical history and performance status

source.quote: Performance status; General and systemic examination

records.tier_basis: listed in the NCG work-up at diagnosis without a tier letter; treated as Essential (the board needs the question and the performance status)
records.note: V2 item 2.4: a clinical record of the owning treating department (route owner); the department named here is the default before a Case File has an owner

records.label: CECT thorax, abdomen and pelvis
records.note: NCG asks for thorax, abdomen and pelvis in one study; a report that names only the thorax counts here and the clinician checks its coverage

records.label: Molecular results (EGFR / ALK / ROS1)
records.note: NCG p5 rates ROS-1 (c) in the metastatic chart and EGFR (b) for squamous histology; the p4 work-up list is followed (clinical review)

records.label: Complete blood count (CBC)

source.quote: CBC, LFT, RFT, Coagulation profile, Viral markers(a)

records.note: coagulation profile and viral markers are listed by NCG but are not checked as fields in V1 (no field in the catalogue). V2 item 2.4: the V1 'Baseline blood tests' record is split by test so each request reaches the desk that does it (CBC: Pathology; LFT / RFT: Biochemistry)

records.label: Liver and renal function tests (LFT, RFT)

records.label: PD-L1 result
records.note: PD-L1 is a gate for pembrolizumab at >50% (T p5), Optimal in NCG

records.label: MRI brain
records.note: Peripheral T1N0 (PET node negative) does not require brain imaging (T p4)

records.label: Mediastinal staging (EBUS / EUS, mediastinoscopy)

sources.quote: Mediastinal staging with PET(a)/ EBUS(b)/ Mediastinoscopy(b)

records.tier_basis: metastatic: NCG lists mediastinal staging (PET a, EBUS b, mediastinoscopy b) for oligometastatic disease (T p5); EBUS / mediastinoscopy kept Optimal in the metastatic setting (the stricter reading; the PET part is the PET-CT record), for clinical review
